seed.reason: version_history/nodes_columnar are deterministic reads over pre-built stores; no RNG in this probe

ceilings.admission_guardrail: bypassed via skip_cost_check=True, per the memo

peak_rss_le_2.5GB_at_10M.measured: treatment median VmHWM at 10M = 1,229,724 KB (1.259 GB); control (format-1, unmodified) = 13,414,332 KB (13.74 GB) -- 10.9x reduction

wall_le_113.7s_at_10M.measured: treatment median wall at 10M = 1,866.8 ms (1.87 s); control = 179,250.1 ms (179.3 s) -- 95.2x faster. Note: control's own wall (~177s avg) and VmHWM (~13.7GB avg) are well above the historical baseline (75.8s / 10.6GB) -- host/data conditions differ from the original D-069 measurement, though this does not affect the treatment-vs-bound comparison, which passes by a wide margin either way

digest_unchanged_84e8853c.measured: scripts/check_digest_stability.py on the treatment engine: 38/38 result_digests unchanged across native and duckdb (19 cases each), rc=0; 84e8853c5d6732deb6d3e4329b46fd5f03770eff399b1099a6b68409be78fbfd confirmed present at frozen_digests_v1.json:257,278 for version_history on both backends

1M_to_10M_peak_rss_ratio_le_2.5x.measured: treatment: 1M median VmHWM = 167,968 KB (0.172 GB), 10M median VmHWM = 1,229,724 KB (1.259 GB) -- ratio 7.33x, exceeding the 2.5x bound despite both absolute numbers individually passing. Per SS4's own wording, this 'refutes the near-flatness claim even if the absolute numbers pass' -- exactly the case here. Plausible mechanism: at 1M the peak is dominated by the fixed per-store floor (uid dictionary + out-degree map, per Addendum 1 item 1), which the 10M store's genuinely larger key array (~320 MB per Addendum 1 item 3) then exceeds.

falsifiers.overall: PARTIALLY REFUTED: all three absolute bounds at 10M pass decisively (10.9x memory / 95.2x wall reduction vs. control, digest unchanged), but the 1M->10M peak-RSS RATIO falsifier is refuted (7.33x vs 2.5x bound), which specifically refutes the design's 'near-flatness' claim even though the bounded-absolute-memory claim holds. The secondary nodes_columnar/SNB-SF1 check was not run (out of scope this lane); the version measured (synth-1m/10m) does not exercise that pathology.
